description: This file defines the Ws class in the Goteo project, which handles web service endpoints related to FAQ, criteria, and review management. It includes methods for retrieving FAQ and criteria order, setting review scores, and posting review comments.

classes.name: Ws
classes.description: Controller class handling web service endpoints for FAQ, criteria order, review scoring, and comments within the Goteo project.

methods.name: get_faq_order
methods.description: Retrieves the next FAQ item for a given section and sends it in the response.

methods.name: get_criteria_order
methods.description: Retrieves the next criteria item for a given section and sends it in the response.

methods.name: set_review_criteria
methods.description: Sets the score for a specific review criterion after validating user permission.

methods.name: set_review_comment
methods.description: Stores a comment related to a review, project, owner, or reward, after validation.
